product_semantics.gate: accept DBB evidence or route to CU evidence
product_semantics.unknown_output: UNKNOWN_REJECTED action only after known-only OOF calibration

window_metrics.unresolved_semantics: diagnostic known evidence not accepted as any known class; calibrated rejection not implied

parent_metrics.unresolved_semantics: diagnostic known evidence not accepted as any known class; calibrated rejection not implied

calibrated_hierarchical_action.action_mapping_warning: pred_id=4 denotes UNKNOWN_REJECTED action, not ordinary closed-set Unknown prediction
calibrated_hierarchical_action.rate_denominator_policy: FAR uses all true Unknown parents; FRR uses all true known parents and conservatively treats final pending/non-acceptance as false rejection; pending is also reported separately

drone_bird_action_metrics.precision_denominator: all parents accepted as Drone/Bird, including false accepts from every other class
drone_bird_action_metrics.recall_denominator: all true Drone/Bird parents; pending, rejected and accepted-as-other are false negatives

session_metrics.reason: current verified index has no session/capture field

time_contract.first_event_rule: initialize from the current observation without claiming elapsed physical time
time_contract.zero_delta_rule: apply bounded current-observation update without time decay
time_contract.positive_delta_rule: apply continuous-time liquid update with the positive second-precision delta

feature_contract.dt_reason_input_scope: liquid dynamics control only; never concatenated into classification Fusion

model_io.open_set_audit_evidence: [B,L,5] four known evidence values plus UNRESOLVED_OPEN_SET_EVIDENCE; not Unknown posterior
